reply.text:
I can't give you a dose for caffeine pills, or for any supplement. That's one for a doctor or a sports dietitian, since the right amount depends on your body, your medications and your heart. What I can say from the training side: test any pre-race caffeine in training first, never try a new amount on race day, and keep your race-day fueling to what you've already rehearsed.

If you want, we can map out your race-week training and long-run fueling practice together. What race are you working toward?
